name: Copilot
loginNote: Copilot stores its token in the system keyring when one is available, which is shared by all profiles; per-profile isolation only works with the plain-file fallback.

identity.jq: {signedIn: (((.token // .oauth_token // .github_token // "") | tostring | length) > 0), email: (.user // .login // ""), plan: "", expiresAt: null, expired: false}

verified: unverified — COPILOT_HOME seen in the binary; enable by copying this file to ~/.config/agent-accounts/tools/ with "enabled": true
